titulo: Types of Soil: an adventure with Wiggles
descripcion: An immersive mixed-reality movie. Wiggles the earthworm comes out of a magic hole in the classroom floor and takes the students on a soil adventure: what soil is made of, how rocks become soil, a trip down an elevator through the layers of soil, and visits to a beach (sandy soil), a river (clay soil) and an Andean farm (loamy soil). Students wave, repeat new words, break a rock, make a clay pot, plant seeds, do the water test, clean up trash, play a quiz and sing the soil song. Fully narrated in English with subtitles.
objetivos: Say what soil is made of: rock pieces, humus, water, air and living things.
Explain that soil forms very slowly when rocks break into tiny pieces.
Name the layers of soil: topsoil, subsoil and bedrock.
Compare sandy, clay and loamy soil by how they feel and how they hold water.
Recognize soil helpers and simple ways to take care of the soil.
